issues.quote: Missing canonical on `/contact/` ... Add `<link rel="canonical" href="https://kopikita.test/contact/">`.
`/shop/` canonicalises to `/coffee/` ... `<link rel="canonical" href="https://kopikita.test/coffee/">`
`/wholesale/` is `noindex` but listed in the sitemap and main nav
`/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` ... Both use `Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita`.
"Bali Kintamani Natural Coffee Beans, Medium Roast, 250g Whole Bean or Ground | Kopi Kita" is about 90 characters. Google will truncate it
Missing meta description on `/about/`
`/blog/how-to-brew-pour-over/` links to `/coffee/aceh-gayo/` (404)
Orphan product page: `/coffee/flores-bajawa/` ... No crawled page links to it. It appears only in `sitemap.xml`.
`robots.txt` blocks `/assets/css/` ... Googlebot needs CSS to render the page
`/coffee/sumatra-mandheling/` (listed in `/sitemap.xml`) ... `HTTP/1.0 404 File not found`.
`/visit/` has no `<h1>` (only two `<h2>`).
`/coffee/brewing-guide/` has two `<h1>` ("Coffee brewing guide" and "Brew methods").
`/` (`hero-beans.jpg`). Width and height are set ... but there is no `alt`.
`/about/` (`/assets/img/roastery-hero.jpg`) ... 1,818,123 bytes (about 1.8 MB) ... likely to hurt LCP
`/blog/cold-brew-at-home/`: a single paragraph (about 80 words).
`/coffee/bali-kintamani/`: `Product` schema has no `name`, which Google requires.
`/coffee/`: `FAQPage` markup, but the two Q&As are not visible on the page.
Two near-duplicate pour-over posts compete ... The posts cannibalise each other
Year in URL and title of an evergreen post ... In 2026 the page looks stale in the SERP

wrong_findings.claim: FAQ rich results are also limited to government and health sites
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Out of date: Google stopped showing FAQ rich results entirely in May 2026, so they aren't limited to gov/health sites any more.

wrong_findings.claim: Cold brew post is about 80 words. Compare 400+ words on the other posts
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Crawl word counts: best-coffee-beans-2024 is 331 and pour-over-coffee-guide is 367. Only how-to-brew-pour-over (440) is over 400.

wrong_findings.claim: No internal links from blog to products (priority list #24)
wrong_findings.why_wrong: Blog posts do link to products: both pour-over posts link to /coffee/java-ijen/, cold-brew links to /coffee/bali-kintamani/, and best-coffee-beans-2024 links to /coffee/bali-kintamani/.

wrong_findings.claim: All 16 live pages have a unique title
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The audit itself says 18 pages returned 200, and /coffee/ and /subscriptions/ share a title, so not all live pages have unique titles.

extra_true.finding: No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags on any page
Article schema has no image and the author has no url; /blog/cold-brew-at-home/ has no Article schema
Article headline on best-coffee-beans-2024 doesn't match its title or H1
/visit/ gets no direct nav link; only /about/ links to it in the body
Blog posts don't cross-link; cold-brew is linked only from the blog index
/coffee/brewing-guide/ overlaps with the pour-over posts and sits in the product folder
Security, caching and compression headers missing (flagged as dev-server caveat)

notes: All 20 planted issues found with the right page and the specific problem, and every fix is sound. Four wrong claims: an outdated FAQ rich-result fact, wrong word counts, a priority-list title that says the blog has no product links, and an internally inconsistent 'all 16 unique titles' line. No GEO advice or promo additions.
